priceSnapshot.note: Up +0.17% since endday's close (83,868.2 -> 84,011.6) in a tight overnight band (83,829.4-84,137.7), the calmest stretch of the last 24h and well inside the day's 83,174.7-85,258.8 range. Still boxed between reduceIf 82,874.5 (untested for a 5th straight session) and addIf 84,944.4 (untested since morning). Funding (+0.0026% from +0.0014%), OI ($2,395.6M from $2,384.3M) and the L/S account ratio (1.36 from 1.29) all ticked up overnight -- a small but real re-build of long positioning without any level actually breaking.

reduceIf.confirmation: Unchanged since the Sep-24 flush -- a settled 1H close below 82,874.5 would end the 5-session hold and signal the recovery has failed. Overnight low 83,829.4 stayed well clear.

addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since morning -- a settled 1H close above 84,944.4 (has capped two attempts already: the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick) would confirm the range top is breaking. Overnight high 84,137.7 stayed well under it.

decisionBox.changed: No level change: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched. What did move overnight -- funding +0.0014%->+0.0026%, OI $2,384.3M->$2,395.6M, L/S ratio 1.29->1.36, Fear&Greed 71->74, and the ETF flow streak extending to 7 days with Sep-25's +134.5M now published -- all point the same modestly-bullish direction without any structural break, hence the tilt shifting to bullish while the position itself stays HOLD.
